title: Enterprise Connectivity: immediate correction ceiling
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this immediate correction ceiling rule to assisted correction posting.

## Basis: ceiling
For assisted correction posting, the immediate assisted correction is bounded at the original source net subtotal multiplied by the matching Support portfolio reduction fraction; any excess requires a distinctly requested correction and is not due in this assistance cycle.

## Basis Q&A
| Assisted correction posting basis | Consequence for this action |
| --- | --- |
| Assisted correction posting: The immediate assisted correction is bounded at the original source net subtotal multiplied by the matching Support portfolio reduction fraction | any excess requires a distinctly requested correction and is not due in this assistance cycle. |

## Hypothetical assistance bound
Assume a hypothetical source net subtotal of USD 240 and a matching support fraction of 0.03. The immediate assistance bound is USD 7.20; this is the assistance ceiling, rather than the entire difference in billed amounts.
